subject: PulseCare — Request: Hosted API tailored discount & terms
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tom Rogers <trogers@pulsecare.ai>, Lydia Park <lydia@pulsecare.ai>
Cc: PulseCare Legal <legal@pulsecare.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PulseCare — Request: Hosted API tailored discount & terms

Team / PulseCare,

Quick context: PulseCare is asking for a deep introductory concession on Hosted API usage pricing to expedite a multi-region roll-out. They are proposing a 12-month committed consumption agreement: estimated $1.2M ARR in year one across US + EU regions, with a 6–9 month ramp. Key asks from the customer:
- 30% off standard token rates for first 12 months
- Minor contract changes: extended data retention (3 years) for audit logs and a separate SLA item for dedicated support during onboarding

Why they matter: PulseCare is a referenceable telehealth platform with strong enterprise logos in our target verticals. They’ve indicated willingness to do a public case study and provide a technical integration engineer for joint enablement. They also want a short SOW to start pilot work immediately.

Attached: pulsecare_pricing_model.xlsx (sensitivity model) and PulseCare_SOW_draft.pdf.

Ask: Need exec sign-off for >20% off (they asked 30%). If approved we’ll lock commercial terms and request DocuSign execution this week. If not approved, customer will revert to competitive offers (they’re evaluating two other platforms).

I recommend: approve up to 30% concession conditioned on: 1) signed 12-month minimum commit ($1.2M), 2) one-time onboarding fee to offset initial support, 3) price reversion clause at renewal to standard rates.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0184

---
Attachment stubs: pulsecare_pricing_model.xlsx (Excel, 120KB), PulseCare_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PulseCare — Request: Hosted API tailored discount & terms

Ben / Karthik,

Thanks for the summary — good opportunity. A few quick clarifying items before I escalate for an exec sign:
1) Net margin impact: please add expected gross margin delta (tokens + support hours) at 25% and 30% concession scenarios.
2) Precedent: do we have recent similar approvals (last 12 months) in health vertical, and were there addenda used for price reversion?
3) Contract asks: the data retention extension will need a legal review — can PulseCare justify operationally why 3 years is required?

I’m amenable to escalating to Marissa for final authorization, but I’d prefer to limit the concession to a 25% cap unless Karthik can make a strong strategic case for 30% (references + clear pipeline expansion within 12 months). Please populate the pricing tab with the margin sensitivity and a short one-paragraph go/no-go recommendation.

If you can get that in the next 24 hours I’ll pull Marissa in with a recommendation.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Deal Desk Operations (interim) | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

---
Quoted:
> Attached: pulsecare_pricing_model.xlsx (sensitivity model) and PulseCare_SOW_draft.pdf.
> Ask: Need exec sign-off for >20% off (they asked 30%).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PulseCare — Request: Hosted API tailored discount & terms

Stephanie / Marissa / Ben,

Thanks — added the sensitivity tab to the attached workbook (pulsecare_pricing_model.xlsx). Summary:
- 25% concession = modest near-term margin compression (~12% gross margin reduction on tokens) but preserves our list pricing after 12 months via a renewal reversion clause.
- 30% concession = higher near-term compression (~18% gross margin reduction) but materially increases probability of closing this quarter; PulseCare has signaled that 30% is a gating factor for choosing us over competitor X.

Strategic justification for a larger concession (30%):
- They’ve committed to a public case study and are willing to participate in a joint sales motion to three named prospects we’ve tracked (these are in the CRM).
- Multi-region rollout gives us a beachhead in two EU hospitals that are otherwise hard to penetrate.

Commercial guardrails I propose if we approve 30%:
1) Signed 12-month minimum consumption and non-refundable onboarding fee of $35k.
2) Clause that tokens above committed volume billed at standard rate.
3) Automatic price reversion at renewal if usage commitments are not met.
4) Legal to sign off on data retention as a scoped appendix (limited to audit logs only; no user PHI stored longer than standard).

Ben: customer is ready to go to contract this week if we commit.

Recommendation: I support up to 30% only if Marissa signs off as exec sponsor; otherwise approve 25% and we proceed.

Karthik Iyer | Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0250

---
Attachment stub: pulsecare_pricing_model.xlsx (updated, Excel, 167KB)

Quoted:
> I’m amenable to escalate to Marissa for final authorization, but I’d prefer to limit the concession to a 25% cap unless Karthik can make a strong strategic case for 30%.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance <finance@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PulseCare — Request: Hosted API tailored discount & terms (EXEC DECISION)

Team / Ben,

Appreciate the fast follow. I reviewed the revenue case, margin sensitivity, and strategic upside Karthik documented. Decision and conditions below.

Executive approval: APPROVED for a 25% introductory discount off Hosted API token rates for the first 12 months. This is an exception to standard pricing and requires the following binding conditions before legal signature:
1) Signed MRR commitment: $1.2M minimum ARR equivalent for the 12-month term (documented in the SOW and commercial schedule).
2) One-time onboarding fee of $35,000 (to be invoiced upfront).
3) Price reversion clause: at renewal, all token pricing reverts to standard list rates unless a new commercial agreement is signed.
4) Usage cap clause: tokens above committed volume billed at list price.
5) Data retention: legal to scope appendix limiting extended retention to non-PHI audit logs only; no change to our PHI storage controls.
6) Public case study / joint sales motion: PulseCare must sign a standard marketing release within 90 days.

Notes: I will not approve a 30% concession at this time without a clearer, quantifiable pipeline commitment tied to that extra discount. If Karthik can secure three named customers from PulseCare pipeline and provide documented introductions within 90 days, we can re-evaluate.

Next steps: Finance and Legal — please prepare concession memo and updated commercial schedule reflecting the 25% concession and the conditions above. Ben — please confirm the customer accepts these conditions and coordinate with Tom/Lydia to sign the SOW.

Marissa Cole | VP, Sales Strategy & Growth, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0119

---
Quoted:
> Recommendation: I support up to 30% only if Marissa signs off as exec sponsor; otherwise approve 25% and we proceed.
